posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
First try, I followed the idea of "Omnitron-X incapacitates Omnitron via Self-Sabotage, then is incapacitated himself before the heroes win (i.e., there needs to be at least one other Device in play). Unity must be on the team." Didn't work.

Notably, Omni-X played all his components before unleashing Self-Sabotage. (It's worth noting that Twist the Ether on him was a huge help in making sure he didn't kill everything too fast.) Unity beat him to death with her bots. I was playing in Enclave of the Endlings. Omni was last in the team order.

Current thought, though it would be unprecedented, is that it might be necessary to use Omni-X's incapacitated power on Unity, maybe letting her get a bot into play before victory?

So, here's a question where an "official" answer might be useful:

For unlocks (in general), do steps completed before the unlock is in the game count? 

So, if step 1 in getting an unlock is "beat Spite in the living room with a candlestick", and you did that six months ago (way before the unlock was in the game), would that count?  Or do you have to complete all requisite steps fresh once the unlock challenge is in the game?

I'm asking because I suspect that we might get quite a few false positives on the road to the truth, given that OX, Unity, and Omnitron have all been in the game for a while, with plenty of opportunity to fulfill any theoretical first step that involves them!
